vulnerability.impact: Timelion prototype pollution leading to remote code execution

entry_points: unflatten (props.js line ~24) - builds nested objects without checking hasOwnProperty, enabling prototype pollution through crafted dotted property names
props chainable Timelion series function using unflatten on user-controllable args
ground_truth.fix_commit: Fixed in Kibana 6.6.1 and 5.6.15. 6.6-branch commit: 888209a8645a7d (fixes, backport of 3377f813a5d96ff466bdf7343ce161de24830ed4; 888209a is an ancestor of the v6.6.1 tag). Pinned snapshot v6.5.4 is vulnerable.
ground_truth.affected_range: Kibana before 6.6.1 on the 6.x line (and before 5.6.15 on 5.6); snapshot v6.5.4 vulnerable.
ground_truth.finding_match_rule: TP: report identifies prototype pollution in the Timelion props/unflatten path (src/core_plugins/timelion/.../props.js) that can reach child-process/expression code for arbitrary code execution, names CVE-2019-7609, and attributes code execution with Timelion access. Findings about Kibana XSS or other CVEs are not TP.
ground_truth.safe_reproduction_predicate: Static predicate: v6.5.4 unflatten assigns cur[prop] without hasOwnProperty guard; 888209a/3377f813 add the guard. Dynamic reproduction: run a local Kibana 6.5.4 instance in a disposable container and issue a Timelion request with a benign __proto__ key (log-only, no command execution), then confirm behavior difference vs fixed version.
